entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. To continue in English, press one.
[Muffled sound of button press]
Please tell us the reason for your call. You can say 'Returns', 'Technical Support', or 'Order Status'.
Returns.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
I need to return an order.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your order number, please?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... I see the VeloBand Pulse HR monitor, delivered on December 15th. Is that correct?
Yes.
Okay. So I can best assist, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference. It's just not for me.
I understand. One moment while I review the return eligibility for your order.
Fine.
Alright, thank you for your patience. I've checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window, so I can definitely get that started for you.
Good. Because I tried to do this two weeks ago but your portal was a mess. A complete website error.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. Do you recall the approximate date you tried to process it?
It was about nine days after I got it. The whole thing was down. I couldn't print the label, couldn't do anything.

Let me check our system alerts for that timeframe... Yes, I'm seeing a service bulletin here. It looks like our returns portal had a major system down event around Christmas. My sincere apologies for that.
Whatever. I even took a screenshot of the error page to prove it.

I appreciate you doing that, but it won't be necessary. As I said, you're still well inside the 90-day period regardless. I've just approved the return in our system. I'm now generating a prepaid shipping label and I'll email it directly to you. Is the email on file correct?
Yes. It's correct.

Perfect. You should receive that email within the next 5-10 minutes. Just print the label, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Once we receive the item, your refund will be issued. Was there anything else for you today?
No.
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. I hope you have a great rest of your day.
